app.name: PureChart
app.description: Turn CSV, JSON, or pasted tables into beautiful, exportable charts.

createEntities.label: Chart
createEntities.description: Create a new chart package from CSV, JSON, or a pasted table.

tools.name: fn_chartWorkspaceBriefing
tools.description: Read a complete single-call PureChart workspace briefing: open document path, every chart on the sheet with Second Look finding counts, focused chart spec and active transform summary, per-column statistical profiles, sample data rows, and ranked chart form recommendations.

sampleRows.description: Number of sample data rows to include (default 10, max 100, 0 to omit rows).

includeFormSuggestions.description: Include ranked chart form recommendations from the current table (default true).

tools.name: fn_auditAndDescribeChart
tools.description: Audit a chart with Second Look perceptual colour/accessibility measurements (OKLab distances, simulated protanopia/deuteranopia, surface contrast, zero-baseline bars, label collisions) and return its exact arithmetic findings, screen-reader description, plotted series coordinates, trend fits, and editorial hygiene in one call.

chartId.description: Optional chart id from the sheet to inspect without changing focus. Defaults to the focused chart.

includePlottedPoints.description: Include up to 50 plotted (xLabel, value) points per series for exact annotation targeting (default false).

tools.name: fn_buildAndReviewChart
tools.description: Configure or add a publication-ready chart in one coordinated call: optionally pick a supported chart form, set title, type, encodings, palette, style, x/y axis labels and units, faceting, trendline, and caption (or auto-generate a data-grounded caption), optionally auto-fix blocking Second Look issues, and immediately return the measured review and arithmetic findings.

mode.description: Update the focused chart (default "update") or add a new chart to the sheet ("add") while keeping existing charts intact.

formIndex.description: Optional index from fn_chartWorkspaceBriefing / suggestChartForms to seed type, encodings, and facet from a validated candidate.

autoSelectForm.description: When true and formIndex is omitted, start from the highest-ranked supported chart form for the current table.

palette.description: Built-in palette id (science, quiet, meadow, ember, mono) or existing custom palette id.

customPalette.description: Create and select a custom palette: { label?, palette?, colors: string[] (#RRGGBB) }.

style.description: Partial style overrides: { rangeFrame?, grid?, directLabels?, rug?, strokeWidth?, pointRadius? }.

axes.description: Optional { x?: { name?, unit?, format? }, y?: { name?, unit?, format? } } (format: plain|grouped|percent|compact).

facet.description: Optional { column: string | null, columns?: number } to split into small multiples or clear faceting.

caption.description: Explicit caption sentence under the chart (empty string clears it).

autoCaptionFromFindings.description: When true (and caption is not provided), compose a data-grounded caption directly from the chart’s computed arithmetic findings.

autoFixBlocking.description: When true, automatically apply deterministic Second Look fixes for any blocking findings before saving.

tools.name: fn_autoFixAndPolishChart
tools.description: Resolve Second Look visual and accessibility findings on the focused chart in one deterministic pass, optionally polishing axis names/units, title, and a data-grounded caption from computed arithmetic findings. Returns before/after blocking counts, every fix applied, and any remaining findings.

severity.description: Fix only "blocking" findings (default) or "all" fixable blocking and check findings.

findingIds.description: Optional exact finding IDs to target instead of fixing all findings at the chosen severity.

axes.description: Optional { x?: { name?, unit?, format? }, y?: { name?, unit?, format? } } (format: plain|grouped|percent|compact).

autoCaptionFromFindings.description: When true and caption is omitted, generate a grounded caption from computed arithmetic findings.

tools.name: fn_batchAnnotateChart
tools.description: Add or replace multiple data-grounded point and range annotations in one validated commit. Automatically resolves omitted point values and computes exact range statistics (count, min, max, average, change) from the plotted series, then validates every target all-or-nothing before mutating the chart.

clearExisting.description: When true, clear existing annotations before adding the new list (escalates risk to destructive). Default false (append).

annotations.description: Items of { text, target }. Point target: { kind: "point", seriesKey, xLabel, value? } (value auto-resolved if omitted). Range target: { kind: "range", x: { from, to }, y?: { from, to }, summary?: { count, min, max, average, change } } (y and summary auto-computed if omitted).

tools.name: fn_exportReadinessCheck
tools.description: Verify whether the focused chart or every chart on the sheet is ready to export as SVG or PNG at the target size and print scale. Checks renderability, caption fit, export dimensions, Second Look blocking findings, optional monochrome print legality, and editorial completeness (title, axes, caption).

scope.description: Check only the focused chart (default "focused") or every chart on the sheet ("sheet").

scale.description: PNG pixel scale (e.g. 3 for print; defaults to 1).

palette.description: Check export in source colours (default) or monochrome print palette.

checkMonochrome.description: Also verify monochrome print legality even when palette is "source" (default false).

tools.name: getChartContext
tools.description: Call this first. Returns the current chart tab context: document path (a .chart package, a legacy .chart.json file, or null while unsaved), title, type, encodings, style, annotation count, and a data summary (columns with types, row count). Column names must be used exactly as returned here.

tools.name: getChartData
tools.description: Return the current chart data columns (with inferred types) and the first rows, capped at 500. Call before choosing encodings or making data-dependent recommendations.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, capped at 500.

tools.name: openChart
tools.description: Call getChartContext first to check the current chart tab before replacing it. Open a chart document (.chart package folder or legacy .chart.json file) or a CSV/TSV/JSON data file by absolute path in the current tab. Fails with a message when the path cannot be read.

tools.name: createChart
tools.description: Create a new unsaved chart in the current tab, optionally seeded with CSV, TSV, or JSON table text; encodings are suggested from the data. This replaces whatever the tab holds — say so when the tab has work. The chart becomes a .chart package draft on its first change; saveChart names the path.

dataText.description: CSV, TSV, or JSON table text to use as inline chart data.

tools.name: proposeChart
tools.description: Preview a coordinated chart edit without modifying the document. Provide a patch and explain data/design choices. The user reviews the preview and applies or discards it in PureChart. Returns changes, validation notes and computed findings. A later proposal replaces the pending preview. Use captionFindingIds from the proposed findings to generate a data-grounded caption; free-form wording is marked for review. Applying is one undoable edit. Source data cannot be changed by this tool.

axes.description: axes configuration matching getChartSpec. Omitted fields at the patch level remain unchanged.

facet.description: facet configuration matching getChartSpec. Omitted fields at the patch level remain unchanged.

transform.description: transform configuration matching getChartSpec. Omitted fields at the patch level remain unchanged.

presentation.description: presentation configuration matching getChartSpec. Omitted fields at the patch level remain unchanged.

annotations.description: Complete replacement annotation list; targets must exist in proposed plotted data.

tools.name: saveChart
tools.description: Save the open chart, creating its .chart package draft in PureDrafts when it has never been saved, and return the path.

tools.name: exportChart
tools.description: Render the chart to SVG or PNG. Renders from the spec, so it works whether or not the chart is on screen. Without a destination the file lands in the chart document's own assets/figures folder (a never-saved chart gets its draft package first). With one, it lands in that folder instead — how a figure is placed into a deck, a report or a manuscript rather than left where only this chart can find it. Give width/height for the size the page needs, and scale for print. The result names the path.

destination.description: Absolute folder (or document package) to write into. Defaults to this chart's own assets/figures.

width.description: Drawing width in px. Defaults to the size on screen.

scale.description: PNG only. Pixels per unit: 3 for print. Defaults to 1.

transparent.description: Leave the ground unpainted, for a figure on a coloured page.

palette.description: The chart’s own colours (default), or one ink for a print edition. The figure remembers which.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureChart's extended specialist tools (24 tools across analysis, annotations, audit, axes, caption, chart, data, design, document, layout, sheet, spec, style) and composite functions (6 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "analysis", "annotations", "audit", "axes", "caption").

category.description: Optional category filter (analysis, annotations, audit, axes, caption, chart, data, design, document, layout, sheet, spec, style, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureChart's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: analysis, annotations, audit, axes, caption, chart, data, design, document, layout, sheet, spec, style). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureChart's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: analysis, annotations, audit, axes, caption, chart, data, design, document, layout, sheet, spec, style). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
